area_assignments.label: Forest
area_assignments.rationale: A solid raised surface is best suited to represent the dense and continuous coverage of forest land.

area_assignments.label: Grassland
area_assignments.rationale: Parallel line hatching is appropriate for the open and expansive nature of grasslands.

area_assignments.label: Field Crops
area_assignments.rationale: A grid pattern represents the highly structured and organized layout of large-scale field crops.

area_assignments.label: Specialty Crops
area_assignments.rationale: Granular dots are suitable for representing the more scattered or intensive planting patterns of specialty crops.
